title: The Trade Desk Inc.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

The Trade Desk is the dominant independent DSP for programmatic advertising, with particularly strong positioning in Connected TV. As streaming platforms add ad tiers (Netflix, Disney+, Amazon Prime), TTD's platform captures incremental budget shifting from linear TV: a secular decade-long reallocation. Unified ID 2.0 is the leading cookieless identity solution, strengthening TTD's position for the post-cookie world. The independence from walled garden conflicts (unlike Google's DV360 or Meta's tools) is a durable competitive advantage with agencies and large advertisers.

Future Tech Roadmap

Connected TV Programmatic Advertising Confident 2025
Addressable streaming TV ads via DSP/SSP: The Trade Desk, Magnite
📈 The Trade Desk is the leading independent DSP for CTV advertising. As streaming ad inventory grows, TTD's platform captures incremental budget shifting from linear TV. This is the core growth driver.
MONOPOLY · 92% no direct rivals identified
Programmatic Display Advertising Confirmed Ongoing
Automated real-time bidding for banner/display/video ad inventory
📈 TTD's core business. Automated real-time bidding for digital ad inventory at scale. Mature but still growing as global digital ad spend increases.
MONOPOLY · 88% no direct rivals identified
Cookieless Tracking / Privacy Sandbox Confident 2026
Post-cookie measurement via cohorts, on-device ML, server-side tagging
📈 TTD's Unified ID 2.0 is the leading alternative identity solution for the post-cookie world. A clean resolution here strengthens TTD's value proposition to advertisers needing reach measurement without cookies.
MONOPOLY · 80% no direct rivals identified
